method: Three fresh VM runs per size, 40 warm commits for 1 KiB and 20 for each MiB size. Mixed workload: 64 commits, concurrency 8, one quarter repeated large input and three quarters unique five-byte streamed bodies. Source creation/hash and linked-sink opening excluded from warm commit latency. Mixed throughput includes opening/writing sinks. Cache-only synthetic bytes; encoding and HTTP omitted. Reconciliation traced with monotonic call/return timestamps; includes filesystem and tracing cost. Startup timing excludes fixture creation. Controlled delay holds the first eviction event synchronously.
